name: Platform-native release
title: A reviewable release workflow
body: Samsarix Creative Spirals turns one campaign into deterministic, reviewable platform drafts without connecting social accounts.

x.body: Turn campaign copy into deterministic, reviewable social drafts—locally, without connecting an account.

linkedin.title: A local-first release communications workflow
linkedin.body: Developer advocates and small teams can now tailor campaign copy for LinkedIn while retaining deterministic identity, semantic review, quality gates, approvals, and publisher-neutral handoff artifacts.

discord.title: Release workflow update
discord.body: Hey community—our local-first campaign tool now supports deliberate copy for each channel. Review the generated draft before pasting it into your server.
